name: William Roche
heroText: I'm a CS student at NYU with a math minor, finishing my senior year and TA-ing Tandon's software engineering course. I like problems that sit where clean abstractions meet messy reality — reconciliation pipelines, tax engines, shells, and the occasional superconducting junction.
aboutText: I'm a senior at NYU studying Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics, after transferring from The College of New Jersey. Most of what I build lives somewhere between finance and systems: FIFO tax engines, real-time market data, ETL pipelines that have to be right the first time. Before that I spent a summer in a quantum hardware lab fabricating graphene Josephson junctions, which taught me more about patience than any codebase has.
